name: Holistics
title: holistics.io
shortDescription: Holistics is a powerful business intelligence (BI) tool designed to empower data teams and business users alike. It allows users to build, manage, and deploy dashboards using code, enabling advanced analytics and data storytelling. Key features include dbt integration, dynamic data sources, and embedded analytics. Ideal for companies looking to streamline their data operations and enhance decision-making capabilities.
pros: Integrates with multiple data sources and dbt
cons: Requires coding knowledge for full utilization
May be complex for non-technical users
Potentially high learning curve for new adopters
